legalAnalysis.summary: Complaints Docket HAR-PNP-2026-CMP-CTY-0001 comprehensively evaluated. Identified 3 primary cognizable offences (BNS 351(3), 331(4), 191(2)) and 2 corroborating provisions (BNS 352, 3(5)).

keyAllegationsIdentified: Physical assault causing grievous hurt (fracture) on victim
Criminal intimidation with threat to life

suggestedSections.sectionTitle: Criminal intimidation by threatening to cause death or grievous hurt
suggestedSections.chapter: Chapter XIX - Of Criminal Intimidation, Insult & Annoyance (Sec 351 - 356)
suggestedSections.description: Whoever commits the offence of criminal intimidation by threatening to cause death or grievous hurt, or destruction of property by fire, or an offence punishable with death or imprisonment for life or for a term which may extend to seven years.
suggestedSections.verbatimSnippet: Section 351(3) BNS: If the threat be to cause death or grievous hurt, or to cause the destruction of any property by fire, or to cause an offence punishable with death or with imprisonment for life, or with imprisonment for a term which may extend to seven years, shall be punished with imprisonment of either description for a term which may extend to seven years, or with fine, or with both.
suggestedSections.punishment: Imprisonment of either description for up to 7 years, or fine, or both
suggestedSections.reason: अभियुक्तों द्वारा प्रार्थी को जान से मारने की सीधी व गंभीर धमकी दी गई। BNS की धारा 351(3) (जान से मारने या गंभीर चोट की धमकी - 7 वर्ष तक कारावास) पूर्णतः लागू होती है।
evidenceProof: Specific verbal threat to kill recorded in complaint
Witness statements corroborating threat to life

suggestedSections.sectionTitle: House-trespass after preparation for causing hurt, assault or wrongful restraint
suggestedSections.chapter: Chapter XVII - Of Offences Against Property (Sec 303 - 334)
suggestedSections.description: Whoever commits house-trespass, having made preparation for causing hurt to any person, or for assaulting any person, or for wrongfully restraining any person, or for putting any person in fear of hurt or of assault or of wrongful restraint.
suggestedSections.verbatimSnippet: Section 331(4) BNS: Whoever commits house-trespass, having made preparation for causing hurt to any person, or for assaulting any person, or for wrongfully restraining any person, or for putting any person in fear of hurt, or of assault, or of wrongful restraint, shall be punished with imprisonment of either description for a term which may extend to seven years, and shall also be liable to fine.
suggestedSections.punishment: Rigorous imprisonment up to 7 years and fine
suggestedSections.reason: अभियुक्त लाठी, डंडों व घातक हथियारों की पूर्व तैयारी के साथ जबरन प्रार्थी की दुकान/मकान में घुसे अथवा घर पर चढ़कर आए तथा भय का माहौल बनाया। BNS की धारा 331(4) (चोट पहुंचाने की तैयारी के साथ गृह-अतिचार - 7 वर्ष तक कारावास) पूर्णतः आकर्षित होती है।
evidenceProof: Allegations of forceful entry/attack at shop/premises with weapons
Inspection verifying trespass

suggestedSections.sectionTitle: Rioting, armed with deadly weapon
suggestedSections.chapter: Chapter XI - Of Offences Against Public Tranquillity (Sec 189 - 197)
suggestedSections.description: Whoever is guilty of rioting, being armed with a deadly weapon or with anything which, used as a weapon of offence, is likely to cause death.
suggestedSections.verbatimSnippet: Section 191(2) BNS: Whoever is guilty of rioting, being armed with a deadly weapon or with anything which, used as a weapon of offence, is likely to cause death, shall be punished with imprisonment of either description for a term which may extend to five years, or with fine, or with both.
suggestedSections.punishment: Imprisonment of either description up to 5 years, or fine, or both
suggestedSections.reason: अभियुक्तों का समूह लाठी, डंडों, लोहे की राड व घातक हथियारों से लैस होकर विधि-विरुद्ध जमाव (Unlawful Assembly) बनाकर आया तथा बलवा किया। BNS की धारा 191(2) (घातक हथियारों से लैस होकर बलवा - 5 वर्ष तक कारावास) पूर्णतः लागू होती है।
evidenceProof: Allegations of armed group/associates with weapons
Recovery/reference of lathis/dandas/iron rods from scene

suggestedSections.sectionTitle: Intentional insult with intent to provoke breach of peace
suggestedSections.chapter: Chapter XIX - Of Criminal Intimidation, Insult & Annoyance (Sec 351 - 356)
suggestedSections.description: Whoever intentionally insults, and thereby gives provocation to any person, intending or knowing it to be likely that such provocation will cause him to break the public peace.
suggestedSections.verbatimSnippet: Section 352 BNS: Whoever intentionally insults, and thereby gives provocation to any person, intending or knowing it to be likely that such provocation will cause him to break the public peace, or to commit any other offence, shall be punished with imprisonment of either description for a term which may extend to two years, or with fine, or with both.
suggestedSections.punishment: Imprisonment up to 2 years, or fine, or both
suggestedSections.reason: अभियुक्त ने प्रार्थी को अकारण गालियां दीं तथा शांति भंग करने के इरादे से उत्तेजित किया। BNS की धारा 352 (शांति भंग कराने के आशय से जानबूझकर अपमान) आकर्षित होती है।
evidenceProof: Verbatim abusive words recorded in intake proforma
Eye-witness verification of altercation

suggestedSections.sectionTitle: Joint criminal liability - Common intention
suggestedSections.chapter: Chapter I - Preliminary & General Explanations (Sec 1 - 3)
suggestedSections.description: When a criminal act is done by several persons in furtherance of the common intention of all, each of such persons is liable for that act in the same manner as if it were done by him alone.
suggestedSections.verbatimSnippet: Section 3(5) BNS: When a criminal act is done by several persons in furtherance of the common intention of all, each of such persons is liable for that act in the same manner as if it were done by him alone.
suggestedSections.punishment: Co-extensive liability with main perpetrators
suggestedSections.reason: घटना में मुख्य आरोपी के साथ अन्य कई व्यक्ति सामान्य आशय की पूर्ति में शामिल थे तथा दबाव बनाया। BNS की धारा 3(5) (साझा आशय / Common Intention) के तहत सभी सह-अभियुक्तों का संयुक्त दायित्व बनता है।
evidenceProof: Multiple accused persons listed in Accused docket
Joint presence and concerted coercion described in allegations

investigativeStepsRecommended: Notice under Section 35(3) BNSS to named accused (जीता, सुरेन्द्र) for recording formal defense explanation.
Preservation & Digital Certification under Section 63(4) BSA of all attached evidence files (3 items).
Verification of hospital MLR records and obtaining formal doctor opinion regarding nature of injury.
Completion of Section 173(3) BNSS preliminary spot verification report within statutory 14-day timeline.

suggestedSections.verbatimSnippet: Section 351(2) BNS: Whoever commits the offence of criminal intimidation shall be punished with imprisonment of either description for a term which may extend to two years, or with fine, or with both; and if threat be to cause death or grievous hurt, with imprisonment up to seven years under Section 351(3).
suggestedSections.punishment: Imprisonment up to 2 years, or fine, or both (Up to 7 years if death threat under 351(3))
suggestedSections.reason: अभियुक्त द्वारा प्रार्थी को जान से मारने की सीधी धमकी दी गई तथा भयभीत किया गया। BNS की धारा 351(2) (आपराधिक अभित्रास / Criminal Intimidation) लागू होती है। यदि धमकी जान से मारने की है, तो 351(3) के अंतर्गत 7 वर्ष तक कारावास का प्रावधान है।
evidenceProof: Threat statement specifically quoted in complainant allegations
Witness statements corroborating oral threats

suggestedSections.sectionTitle: Intentional insult with intent to provoke breach of peace
suggestedSections.chapter: Chapter XIX - Of Criminal Intimidation, Insult & Annoyance (Sec 351 - 356)
suggestedSections.description: Whoever intentionally insults, and thereby gives provocation to any person, intending or knowing it to be likely that such provocation will cause him to break the public peace.
suggestedSections.verbatimSnippet: Section 352 BNS: Whoever intentionally insults, and thereby gives provocation to any person, intending or knowing it to be likely that such provocation will cause him to break the public peace, or to commit any other offence, shall be punished with imprisonment of either description for a term which may extend to two years, or with fine, or with both.
suggestedSections.punishment: Imprisonment up to 2 years, or fine, or both
suggestedSections.reason: अभियुक्त ने सार्वजनिक स्थान पर प्रार्थी को अकारण गालियां दीं तथा शांति भंग करने के इरादे से उत्तेजित किया। BNS की धारा 352 (शांति भंग कराने के आशय से जानबूझकर अपमान) आकर्षित होती है।
evidenceProof: Verbatim abusive words recorded in intake proforma
Eye-witness verification of public altercation

suggestedSections.sectionTitle: Joint criminal liability - Common intention
suggestedSections.chapter: Chapter I - Preliminary & General Explanations (Sec 1 - 3)
suggestedSections.description: When a criminal act is done by several persons in furtherance of the common intention of all, each of such persons is liable for that act in the same manner as if it were done by him alone.
suggestedSections.verbatimSnippet: Section 3(5) BNS: When a criminal act is done by several persons in furtherance of the common intention of all, each of such persons is liable for that act in the same manner as if it were done by him alone.
suggestedSections.punishment: Co-extensive liability with main perpetrators
suggestedSections.reason: घटना में मुख्य आरोपी के साथ अन्य कई व्यक्ति (10-12 लोग) सामान्य आशय की पूर्ति में शामिल थे तथा समझौते के नाम पर दबाव बनाया। BNS की धारा 3(5) (साझा आशय / Common Intention) के तहत सभी सह-अभियुक्तों का संयुक्त दायित्व बनता है।
evidenceProof: Multiple accused persons listed in Accused docket
Joint presence and concerted coercion described in allegations

suggestedSections.sectionTitle: Preliminary Enquiry (14 Days Window Prior to FIR)
suggestedSections.chapter: Chapter XII - Information to Police & Powers to Investigate (Sec 173 - 196)
suggestedSections.description: On receipt of information relating to commission of cognizable offence punishable with 3 to 7 years, officer in charge of police station may conduct preliminary enquiry within 14 days with prior permission of DSP.
suggestedSections.verbatimSnippet: Section 173(3) BNSS: On receipt of information relating to the commission of any cognizable offence, which is made punishable for three years or more but less than seven years, the officer in charge of the police station may with the prior permission from an officer not below the rank of Deputy Superintendent of Police, considering the nature and gravity of the offence— (i) proceed to conduct preliminary enquiry to ascertain whether there exists a prima facie case for proceeding in the matter, which shall be completed within a period of fourteen days; or (ii) proceed with investigation when there exists a prima facie case.
suggestedSections.punishment: Statutory Procedural Mandate (14-day completion binding on Police)
suggestedSections.reason: वर्तमान शिकायत में लगाए गए आरोपों की सजा 3 वर्ष से 7 वर्ष के मध्य आती है। नए आपराधिक कानून BNSS 2023 की धारा 173(3) के अनुसार, नियमित FIR दर्ज करने से पहले 14 दिनों के भीतर प्राथमिक जांच (Preliminary Enquiry) पूर्ण करना अनिवार्य कानूनी प्रक्रिया है।
evidenceProof: BNSS 173(3) enquiry docket open for Station District Police Office Panipat
Mandatory supervisory directions issued by SHO to Enquiry Officer

suggestedSections.sectionTitle: Mandatory Notice of Appearance to Suspect Instead of Arrest
suggestedSections.chapter: Chapter V - Arrest of Persons (Sec 35 - 62)
suggestedSections.description: The police officer shall, in all cases where arrest of a person is not required, issue a notice directing the person against whom a reasonable complaint has been made, to appear before him.
suggestedSections.verbatimSnippet: Section 35(3) BNSS: The police officer shall, in all cases where the arrest of a person is not required under sub-section (1), issue a notice directing the person against whom a reasonable complaint has been made, or credible information has been received, or a reasonable suspicion exists that he has committed a cognizable offence, to appear before him or at such other place as may be specified in the notice.
suggestedSections.punishment: Procedural Compliance (Protection against arbitrary arrest)
suggestedSections.reason: अभियुक्त के विरुद्ध आरोपों में यदि सजा 7 वर्ष से कम है, तो BNSS धारा 35(3) के अंतर्गत सीधे गिरफ्तारी के स्थान पर विधिवत उपस्थिति नोटिस (Notice of Appearance) जारी कर उनका पक्ष दर्ज करना कानूनी बाध्यता है।

Required Section 35(3) Appearance Proforma in Documents Tab
